tools.name: prepare_attachment_upload
tools.description:
DEPRECATED TRANSPORT — REMOVAL DATE 2026-04-08 (past). The /sse transport on this server is deprecated. Replacement endpoint: https://mcp.linear.app/mcp. Migration guide: https://linear.app/docs/mcp.

Prepare a direct Linear file upload for an existing issue.

Workflow:
1. Call this tool with issue, filename, contentType, and size.
2. Upload raw bytes with PUT to uploadRequest.url outside MCP.
3. All headers in uploadRequest.headers are part of the signed request, so send them verbatim.
4. After PUT succeeds, call create_attachment_from_upload with assetUrl to link it to the issue.

Do not base64-encode or transform the file. Use curl --data-binary @path or fetch(url, { method: 'PUT', body: blob }).
Omitting or modifying any signed header, including casing, will return HTTP 403.
The signed URL must be used within 60 seconds or it will expire.

Upload sequencing:
Prepare, PUT, and finalize one file before calling this tool for another file.
Do not batch multiple prepare_attachment_upload calls before starting the PUTs because earlier signed URLs can expire while later files are prepared.

Example:
curl -X PUT --data-binary @file.png \
  -H "content-type: image/png" \
  -H "x-goog-content-length-range: N,N" \
  -H "cache-control: public, max-age=31536000" \
  -H 'Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="file.png"' \
  "<uploadRequest.url>"

size.description: Exact file size in bytes. Must be smaller than 2 GB.

title.description: Suggested attachment title for the finalize step

filename.description: Filename for the upload, e.g. screenshot.png

subtitle.description: Suggested attachment subtitle for the finalize step

contentType.description: MIME type, e.g. image/png or application/pdf

tools.name: create_attachment_from_upload
tools.description:
DEPRECATED TRANSPORT — REMOVAL DATE 2026-04-08 (past). The /sse transport on this server is deprecated. Replacement endpoint: https://mcp.linear.app/mcp. Migration guide: https://linear.app/docs/mcp.

Link an already-uploaded Linear assetUrl to an existing issue as an attachment.

Use this only after:
1. prepare_attachment_upload returned an assetUrl and uploadRequest.
2. The client successfully PUT raw file bytes to uploadRequest.url.

This tool does not upload file content. It only creates the Linear attachment row.
If the direct upload failed or the signed URL expired, rerun prepare_attachment_upload and upload again.

title.description: Attachment title. Defaults to filename or asset URL

assetUrl.description: Linear upload assetUrl returned by prepare_attachment_upload

tools.name: prepare_attachment_upload
tools.description:
Prepare a direct Linear file upload for an existing issue.

Workflow:
1. Call this tool with issue, filename, contentType, and size.
2. Upload raw bytes with PUT to uploadRequest.url outside MCP.
3. All headers in uploadRequest.headers are part of the signed request, so send them verbatim.
4. After PUT succeeds, call create_attachment_from_upload with assetUrl to link it to the issue.

Do not base64-encode or transform the file. Use curl --data-binary @path or fetch(url, { method: 'PUT', body: blob }).
Omitting or modifying any signed header, including casing, will return HTTP 403.
The signed URL must be used within 60 seconds or it will expire.

Upload sequencing:
Prepare, PUT, and finalize one file before calling this tool for another file.
Do not batch multiple prepare_attachment_upload calls before starting the PUTs because earlier signed URLs can expire while later files are prepared.

Example:
curl -X PUT --data-binary @file.png \
  -H "content-type: image/png" \
  -H "x-goog-content-length-range: N,N" \
  -H "cache-control: public, max-age=31536000" \
  -H 'Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="file.png"' \
  "<uploadRequest.url>"

size.description: Exact file size in bytes. Must be smaller than 2 GB.

issue.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues

title.description: Suggested attachment title for the finalize step

filename.description: Filename for the upload, e.g. screenshot.png

subtitle.description: Suggested attachment subtitle for the finalize step

contentType.description: MIME type, e.g. image/png or application/pdf

title.description: Attachment title. Defaults to filename or asset URL

tools.name: create_attachment
tools.description:
Deprecated fallback for tiny files only. Accepts base64 file content, verifies SHA-256 checksum, and uploads it through the MCP worker.
Prefer `prepare_attachment_upload` plus direct PUT plus `create_attachment_from_upload`.

CRITICAL: Do not print base64Content and then copy it into this tool call.
Opaque base64 copied through model-visible text is easy to corrupt.

Generate base64Content mechanically from the source bytes and pass it through a programmatic argument construction path whenever available. Before calling this tool, verify the values are consistent:

Unix-like shells:
file="/path/to/file"
base64Content=$(base64 < "$file" | tr -d '\n\r')
sha256=$(shasum -a 256 "$file" | awk '{print $1}')
decodedSha256=$(printf '%s' "$base64Content" | base64 -d | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')
size=$(wc -c < "$file" | tr -d ' ') # optional; stat can also get file byte size
decodedSize=$(printf '%s' "$base64Content" | base64 -d | wc -c | tr -d ' ')

PowerShell:
$file = 'C:\path\to\file'
$bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file)
$base64Content = [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
$sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -Path $file).Hash.ToLower()
$size = $bytes.Length # optional
$decoded = [Convert]::FromBase64String($base64Content)
$decodedStream = [IO.MemoryStream]::new($decoded)
$decodedSha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -InputStream $decodedStream).Hash.ToLower()
$decodedSize = $decoded.Length

decodedSha256 must equal sha256. If you pass size, decodedSize must equal size.
Pass `sha256`. Passing `size` is optional, but recommended for clearer mismatch errors.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List teams in the user's Linear workspace

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific Linear team

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the Linear issue, project, and document templates available to the authenticated user. Use this to find the template a team expects, then call get_template for its content.

team.description: Team name or ID. Returns that team's templates plus workspace-level ones

type.description: Filter by template type. Omit to return every type

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Retrieve a Linear template by ID or name: the content it pre-fills, the ids it applies, its sub-issues, and its form fields. Pass the template to save_issue or save_project to apply it. References come back as ids, so read a name with the matching tool when you need one. A form template collects its answers through a form, so applying one here creates an issue with the form unanswered.

tools.description: Retrieve the connected Linear workspace

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the user's Linear workspace

tools.name: save_customer
tools.description: Create or update a Linear customer. If `id` is provided, updates the existing customer; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `name` is required.

id.description: Customer ID. If provided, updates the existing customer

domains.description: Domains to add to this customer. Append-only; existing domains are never removed

revenue.description: Annual revenue generated by the customer

externalIds.description: External system IDs to add. Append-only; existing IDs are never removed

tools.name: delete_customer
tools.description: Delete a customer in Linear

tools.name: save_customer_need
tools.description: Create or update a customer need (request) in Linear. If `id` is provided, updates the existing need; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `body` is required.

id.description: Customer need ID. If provided, updates the existing need

body.description: Description of the customer need (required when creating)

issue.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues to associate with this need

source.description: URL to attach as the source for this customer need, such as a transcript or support thread

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug to associate with this need

priority.description: Whether the need is important. 0 = Not important, 1 = Important

tools.name: delete_customer_need
tools.description: Archive a customer need in Linear

tools.name: list_initiatives
tools.description: List initiatives in the user's Linear workspace

fields.description: Fields to include in each result. `id` is always included. Omit or pass an empty array for the default response.

leadTeam.description: Lead team name, key, or ID

parentInitiative.description: Parent initiative. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

tools.name: get_initiative
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific initiative in Linear

query.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

tools.name: save_initiative
tools.description: Create or update a Linear initiative. If `id` is provided, updates the existing initiative; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `name` is required. To change parts of the description without resending all of it, pass `patch` instead of `description`.

id.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug. If provided, updates the existing initiative

icon.description: Icon name or emoji code (e.g. "Rocket" or ":eagle:"), not a raw Unicode emoji

owner.description: User ID, name, email, or "me". Null to remove

new_string.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the match

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match the current content exactly once

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match

text.description: Text to insert directly before the anchor. Include separators (e.g. "\n\n")

anchor.description: Exact text to insert before. Must match the current content exactly once

text.description: Text to insert directly after the anchor. Include separators (e.g. "\n\n")

anchor.description: Exact text to insert after. Must match the current content exactly once

text.description: Text to insert at the very start of the content
Text to insert at the very end of the content

to.description: Exact text where the range ends (exclusive, stays in place). Must match exactly once after `from`

from.description: Exact text where the range starts (inclusive). Must match exactly once

new_string.description: Text replacing the range. Empty string deletes it

patch.description: Partial edits applied to the current content, in order and atomically (one failing operation aborts the whole save). Every anchor string must match the current content exactly once. Only valid on update, in place of the full content/description field

labels.description: Label names or IDs as a JSON array of strings (e.g. ["Bug", "Urgent"]). Replaces the full label set; existing labels not included are removed. Omit to leave labels unchanged

status.description: Initiative status (Proposed, Planned, Active, Completed, Canceled)

leadTeam.description: Lead team name, key, or ID. Null to remove the lead team

description.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

parentInitiatives.description: Parent initiatives to add. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug. Appended to existing parents

tools.name: list_initiative_labels
tools.description: List available initiative labels in the Linear workspace. A retired label carries `retiredAt` and cannot be applied to new initiatives.

includeGroups.description: Include label groups in the results, marked with `isGroup`. A group cannot be applied directly; retiring or restoring one cascades to its child labels

tools.name: save_initiative_label
tools.description: Create or update a Linear initiative label. If `id` is provided, updates the existing label; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `name` is required.

id.description: Label name or ID. If provided, updates the existing label

parent.description: Parent label group name or ID. Null to remove from its group

isGroup.description: Whether the label is a group

description.description: Label description. Null to clear it

tools.name: create_initiative_label
tools.description: Create a new Linear initiative label. Deprecated: use `save_initiative_label`, which can also update labels.

parent.description: Parent label group name or ID

isGroup.description: Whether the label is a group

tools.name: retire_initiative_label
tools.description: Retire a Linear initiative label so it cannot be applied to new initiatives. The label stays visible on initiatives that already have it. Retiring a label group also retires its child labels. Undo with `restore_initiative_label`.

tools.name: restore_initiative_label
tools.description: Restore a retired Linear initiative label, making it available for use on initiatives again. Restoring a label group also restores every child label, including any that were retired separately.

tools.name: get_status_updates
tools.description: List or get project/initiative status updates. Pass `id` to get a specific update, or filter to list.

id.description: Status update ID - if provided, returns this specific update

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

tools.name: save_status_update
tools.description: Create or update a project/initiative status update. Omit `id` to create, provide `id` to update.

id.description: Status update ID - if provided, updates this existing update

body.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

isDiffHidden.description: Deprecated. Hide diff with previous update (create only)

tools.name: delete_status_update
tools.description: Delete (archive) a project or initiative status update.
